title: DocsPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchLinkedDocsPanel, which draws its own MonarchSectionCard; DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch) and .task to load on open; on iPhone a NavigationLink row in a List that pushes a screen with the panel
summary: A recipe, not a component: the record-page block for linked docs and links, as MonarchLinkedDocsPanel in a record screen, behind a Docs disclosure that loads only when opened, or as a Docs row that opens its own screen on iPhone.
whenToUse: On a record's detail screen, to show and manage the docs and links attached to the record; behind a disclosure or a row in long screens so docs load only when someone opens them.
whenNotToUse: For files uploaded to the record, use the file list components. To pick one doc, use a Picker or MonarchCombobox.
api: List { NavigationLink { MonarchLinkedDocsPanel(…) } label: { LabeledContent("Docs", value: "2") } }

options.name: frame
options.description: MonarchLinkedDocsPanel already draws a section card; the web's divider and none frames have no separate form.

options.name: collapsible
options.description: Wrap the panel in a DisclosureGroup with the Monarch style; its content is built only while expanded, so load the items in .task there.

options.name: row
options.description: On iPhone, a Docs row with the count that pushes a screen holding the panel: the usual pattern for a section of a record.

options.name: count
options.description: When the app already knows how many docs are linked, put it in the disclosure label or the row's value.

states.name: open
states.description: The panel with its items, actions and space filter, from MonarchLinkedDocsPanel.

states.name: closed
states.description: Only the Docs disclosure or row; nothing is loaded.

states.name: loading
states.description: items is nil: the panel's loading state while the app fetches.

states.name: read only
states.description: isReadOnly: true shows the items without link, add or unlink actions.

appearance: MonarchLinkedDocsPanel's section card; the Monarch disclosure header when collapsible; the system list row with a chevron for the row form. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those parts.
platformNotes: The web ships DocsPanel with a frame prop (card, divider, none) and a collapsible mode with its own disclosure button and strings. On iOS MonarchLinkedDocsPanel is already the card and DisclosureGroup is the disclosure, so DocsPanel is a recipe, as on Android. The toggle text and count are the disclosure's label, and loading on open is a .task inside the disclosure's content, which SwiftUI builds only while expanded. On iPhone a record's sections are usually rows that push their own screen, so the recipe also shows a NavigationLink row. The web's doc icon is left out of the label. Experimental, like MonarchLinkedDocsPanel, until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The disclosure is one button read with Expanded or Collapsed, from DisclosureGroup and the Monarch style.
The count is part of the disclosure's label or the row's value, so it is read with it.
The row is a NavigationLink, read as a button that opens a screen.
Inside, the panel's title is a heading and its actions are Monarch buttons with 44-point targets, from MonarchLinkedDocsPanel.
edgeCases: Closing the disclosure removes the panel: keep the items in the record's state, above it.
Without a known count, label the disclosure or row Docs only.
Items that fail to load: pass errorMessage and onRetry to the panel.

examples.title: On a record page
examples.template:
MonarchLinkedDocsPanel(
    items,
    onAddLink: { _, _ in },
    onUnlink: { item in items?.removeAll { $0.id == item.id } },
    onOpen: { _ in }
)
.accessibilityLabel({{heading}})
.task {
    items = [
        MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem(
            id: {{items.0.id}},
            title: {{items.0.title}},
            kind: .{{items.0.kind|raw}},
            url: URL(string: {{items.0.href}}),
            docID: {{items.0.docId}},
            meta: {{items.0.meta}},
            status: {{items.0.status}},
            spaceID: {{items.0.space.id}},
            spaceName: {{items.0.space.name}}
        ),
        MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem(
            id: {{items.1.id}},
            title: {{items.1.title}},
            kind: .{{items.1.kind|raw}},
            url: URL(string: {{items.1.href}})
        ),
    ]
}
examples.code:
MonarchLinkedDocsPanel(

    onAddLink: { _, _ in },
    onUnlink: { item in items?.removeAll { $0.id == item.id } },

.task {
    items = [
        MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem(
            id: "l1",

        ),

}
